name: 01_cut_dough
title: Dough Slicing and Stove Prep
summary: A dual-arm robot slices dough on a cutting board, moves a piece to the stovetop, covers it, and checks back between workstations.
robot: two black dexterous robotic arms with multi-finger grippers
setting: a kitchen counter with a cutting board, condiment bottles, and a gas stove

source.original_prompt: Cut the dough into small pieces with a knife using both hands

segments.instruction: Press the knife down using both hands to slice through the dough log. The camera stays focused on the cutting board.
Lift the blade, cut a second slice, and set the knife flat on the board. The camera remains still.
Pick up a sliced dough piece with the right hand while the camera turns right toward the stovetop.
segments.memory_event: hide: cutting board, knife, and condiment counter pan out of view

segments.instruction: Place the dough piece onto the stove tray and reach toward the lid next to it. The camera stays on the stove.
Place the lid over the dough piece on the tray. The camera remains fixed on the stove.
segments.memory_event: hide: dough piece on the tray is covered by the lid

segments.instruction: Move the hands back toward the counter as the camera turns left to face the cutting board.
segments.memory_event: return: cutting board with the sliced dough log and resting knife reappears exactly as left

segments.instruction: Pick up another dough slice with the right hand while the camera pans right back to the stovetop.
Lift the lid off the tray with the left hand. The camera stays focused on the stove.
segments.memory_event: return: first dough piece reappears uncovered on the tray
